versions.name: Forestry
versions.description: Identify fifteen trees, shrubs, and vines growing in nearby woods, read growth rings and pest damage for the story they tell, and learn how foresters manage stands for timber, water, wildlife, and fire.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
